name: Buu Minh Pagoda
kicker: Tea-hill pagoda north of the lake
summary: Walk Buu Minh Pagoda, the tea-hill temple north of Pleiku. The hall is 520 square metres, and the tower rises more than 47 m from the hall floor. Another account gives the hall as 25 m high. It sits about 15 km north, or more than 15 km. It is not Minh Thanh, the gold tower above town. Hours and any donation are Check on arrival.
getThere: North of Pleiku, in the tea hills of Nghĩa Hưng, about 15 km or more than 15 km
heroCaption: The hall and the tower in the courtyard

notice.title: Not Minh Thanh Pagoda
notice.body: Minh Thanh is the gold tower on the hill above Pleiku. Buu Minh stands in the tea hills of Nghĩa Hưng, Chư Păh, north of the lake.

body: Walk the courtyard and the hall. The west front looks toward Biển Hồ, and Tiên Sơn sits behind the roofs. The hall is 520 square metres. The tower rises more than 47 m from the hall floor. Another account gives the hall as 25 m high. The roofs pitch at 45 degrees, with the tower set into the back roof, in the shape of a highland communal house.

The pagoda is also called Chùa Biển Hồ Trà. It sits in the tea hills, so you can stop on the same northern loop as the lake, and the visit is still the hall, not the shore. Stay off the harvest paths around the rows. It is not Minh Thanh.
From Pleiku the ride is about 15 km north, or more than 15 km. The last stretch runs through a pine avenue. Minutes, the fare, the hours, and any donation are Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The tower from the garden bridge and the pond
figures.alt: Multi-tier tower of Buu Minh Pagoda behind a brick garden bridge and a lotus pond

gettingThere: Buu Minh stands in Nghĩa Hưng, Chư Păh, north of Pleiku, in the tea hills. One account puts it 15 km from the center. Another puts it more than 15 km. The last stretch is a pine avenue. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku
legs.body: By taxi or ride-hail, north into the tea hills. About 15 km, or more than 15 km. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Hours and any donation are Check on arrival. No child rule is set out for the gate.
